highlights.title: Upcoming: Codeforces Round (Div. 2)
highlights.detail: The upcoming Codeforces Round (Div. 2) is a competitive programming contest that will take place on August 17. Participants will have 2 hours to solve the problems, and the contest will start at 14:35 UTC.

highlights.title: Grading Tomatoes with an ESP32 and ML
highlights.summary: ESP32 and ML used for grading tomatoes
highlights.detail: The project uses an ESP32 board and machine learning to grade tomatoes based on their quality. This application of ML in agriculture can help improve the efficiency of the grading process.

highlights.title: TauricResearch/TradingAgents
highlights.detail: The TradingAgents framework is a multi-agent framework for financial trading using large language models. This framework can be used to develop and test trading strategies using ML and LLMs.

highlights.title: google-ai-edge/LiteRT
highlights.summary: LiteRT, successor to TensorFlow Lite, released
highlights.detail: LiteRT is an on-device framework for high-performance ML and GenAI deployment on edge platforms. It provides efficient conversion, runtime, and optimization capabilities, making it a suitable successor to TensorFlow Lite.

highlights.title: 666ghj/MiroFish
highlights.detail: The MiroFish engine is a simple and universal swarm intelligence engine that can be used for predicting various phenomena. It demonstrates the application of swarm intelligence in ML and AI.

items.title: High-Density Parchment Paper Papertronics with Laser-Carved Hydrophilic Channels
items.summary: Papertronics with laser-carved hydrophilic channels developed
items.detail: The project explores the use of paper as a substrate for electronic circuits, which can lead to flexible and low-cost circuits. The use of laser-carved hydrophilic channels is a novel approach in this field.

items.title: Junkbin, a Way to Efficiently Reuse Your Old Electronics
items.summary: Junkbin project for reusing old electronics introduced
items.detail: The Junkbin project aims to encourage the reuse of old electronics by providing a platform for creative repurposing. This can help reduce electronic waste and promote sustainability.

items.title: Robotic Screw and Bolt Sorter Seeks a New Challenge
items.summary: Robotic screw and bolt sorter developed
items.detail: The robotic sorter uses automation to sort mixed bolts and screws, which can be a time-consuming task. This project demonstrates the application of robotics in improving workshop efficiency.

items.title: Tim Hunkin’s History Of Arcade Machines
items.summary: Tim Hunkin's history of arcade machines presented
items.detail: The presentation by Tim Hunkin provides a historical overview of arcade machines, highlighting their evolution and impact on the gaming industry. This talk can be a valuable resource for those interested in gaming history.

items.title: Track Bird Visitors With a Raspberry Pi and a USB Mic
items.summary: Raspberry Pi project for tracking bird visitors introduced
items.detail: The Avian Visitors project uses a Raspberry Pi and microphone to track and identify bird species visiting a location. This project demonstrates the application of ML and IoT in wildlife monitoring.
